Actor.Name: Name:
Actor.InjuryHint1: Once down, take 1 injury each turn.
Actor.InjuryHint2: Allies heal 1 injury with a Medical roll.
Actor.RollOnYourTurn: Roll against current target on your turn
Actor.RollOnEnemyTurn: Roll against current target on enemy turn or event

Weapon.DiscardOthers: Discard all other weapons when equipped
Weapon.Destroyed: {name} is destroyed and cannot be used.

Xeno.BriefingStep2: Move and resolve all XENOS in SEEK mode.
Xeno.BriefingStep3: When XENOS contact COMMANDOS, they always attack! COMMANDOS then need to roll RESISTANCE to survive. Which roll they need to make is determined by battle conditions:
Xeno.BriefingRule1: Roll FEAR when XENOS appear from HIDE mode to SEEK mode.
Xeno.BriefingRule3: Roll DEATH when XENOS SPAWN IN CONTACT with a COMMANDO — this gruesome event is also called an AMBUSH.

MapGenerator.Title: Map Generator
MapGenerator.SplitAreasHint: Adds one scene per Area (4 Locations each), linked back to the full map with teleport regions outside each cross-Area door.

Escalation.Title: ESCALATION
Escalation.BreederDialogContent:
A giant Breeder XENO joins the fight via a LOCATION ROLL.

If the current OBJECTIVE is Kill the Breeder, this is a second one — there are now two.
Escalation.SwarmErupts: {count} XENOS erupt at the COMMANDOS' location!

Notifications.NoCommandoTokens: No COMMANDO tokens on the scene.
Notifications.NoLocationTiles: No LOCATION tiles on this scene.

Info.EscapePod: Once EVAC is unlocked, make it here to eject! You'll be to the frontier in a few weeks
Info.Bridge: Flight control, ship's diagnostics, and reactor-destruct terminal
Info.EngineRoom: A cramped mechanical maze with high heat, bad visibility and steam vents
Info.Airlock: Door to the exterior of the ship. Can take extra time to open
Info.MedBay: Creepy white-plastic lab feel, with supplies, canisters, and gurneys
Info.Quarters: Messy living space with a homey feel, but eerie quiet
Info.Galley: Community cooking and eating facilities with bright fluorescent lighting
Info.Refinery: Caution stripes, alert lights, hand rails and piping. A baffling environment
Info.Hydroponics: Humid, damp geodesic dome with ferns, vegetable crops and oxygen rich plants
Info.Garage: Storage for excavators, buggies, loaders and other vehicles
Info.LoadingBay: Huge, cavernous warehouse space littered with reinforced crates and air tanks
Info.Corridor: A long hallway that connects 2 or more AREAS
Info.Crawlspace: Narrow ducts and sub floors normally unused by humans
Info.Sump: A catch for waste water and trash ship-wide. The muck is processed into space
Info.ObsDeck: Huge bowed windows that look out onto the desolate beauty of deep space
Info.LifeSupport: Air scrubbers rumble here as they recycle the air and maintain temperature

Info.LandingPad: Used for on-planet air ops and orbital drop ship dust-off
Info.RadioDish: Huge uplink dish that is susceptible to bad weather or mechanical failure
Info.Command: Central surveillance, systems control, and meeting chambers
Info.MedBay: Large medical facility with extensive supplies, quarantine, and ER capability
Info.Armory: Weapons and tools storage. Also contains hazmat and vac suits
Info.Refinery: Power and fuel reclamation on a large scale, complete with volatile liquids and piping
Info.Reactor: The central power cell for the colony. Radiation hazard
Info.Cafeteria: The white tile and pressed tin trays make this a creepy place to see a XENO
Info.Causeway: A huge central public space that connects 3 or 4 AREAS of the COLONY
Info.Surface: These exo planets are all the same: brutal cold, howling wind, sharp rocks, XENOS
Info.Residential: Living quarters for families. Now a graveyard
Info.Dump: Construction debris, waste water, and heaps of residential trash in massive compactors
Info.Substructure: Beneath the colony floor levels are labyrinths of maintenance tubes and girders
Info.MotorPool: Chained-down dozers, loaders, excavators, buggies and drilling vehicles
Info.PotatoFarm: Where the food is grown for the entire colony. Tall, thick crops make it a tactical nightmare
Info.Astrophysics: The science communities on exo planets need state of the art facilities

SweepAndClear.Label: Sweep and Clear
SweepAndClear.Desc: Go room by room through the current area and eliminate any XENO threats. Kill 'em all! Make 3 LOCATION ROLLS %LOC1% %LOC2% %LOC3% to determine 3 LOCATIONS. COMMANDOS must kill all XENOS in these areas.

RestorePower.Label: Restore Power
RestorePower.Desc: Restore power to a critical system or area. Find the generator, splice a cable, or locate the right terminal or switch. Make a LOCATION ROLL %LOC1% to determine where the generator, cable, or terminal is located. COMMANDOS must reach this LOCATION and spend 1D4 rounds defending it while the system is activated.

AnomalyRecon.Label: Anomaly Recon
AnomalyRecon.Desc: The "Brass" want a certain odd location investigated. What could be causing the anomaly? Moreover, what could be lurking there? Go check it out. Make a LOCATION ROLL %LOC1% to place the anomaly. COMMANDOS must reach this LOCATION and roll an extra ESCALATION to determine its nature. Get the data and get out.

FallBack.Label: Fall Back!
FallBack.Desc: The Xenos have overwhelming numbers! Retreat "by the numbers" and fall back to a rally point before proceeding any further. Make a LOCATION roll %LOC1% to determine the rally point. COMMANDOS must reach this location and spend 1D4 rounds defending it.

RescueTheColonists.Label: Rescue the Colonists
RescueTheColonists.Desc: Proceed to the next location and rescue at least 50% of 4D20 cocooned colonists. Make a LOCATION roll %LOC1% to place them. Rescue as many colonists per ROUND as there are COMMANDOS in your squad.

ExterminateTheAlpha.Label: Exterminate the Alpha
ExterminateTheAlpha.Desc: This is a seek and destroy mission. Find the swarm-leader and terminate it with extreme prejudice. Make a LOCATION ROLL to determine the LOCATION %LOC1%.

DestroyTheHive.Label: Destroy the Hive
DestroyTheHive.Desc: Find the egg chamber and make sure every nasty crawling thing in there is dead. Make a LOCATION ROLL %LOC1% to determine the LOCATION of the egg chamber. Once there, destroy 1D20 eggs to complete the OBJECTIVE.

RepairTheMachinery.Label: Repair the Machinery
RepairTheMachinery.Desc: Proceed to the right location and repair or activate a large piece of machinery: a generator, the entire power grid, or a life support system. Make a LOCATION ROLL %LOC1% to determine where the generator, power grid, or system is located. COMMANDOS must reach this LOCATION and spend 1D4 rounds defending it while repairs are conducted.

Stronghold.Label: Stronghold
Stronghold.Desc: The Xenos are advancing in large waves! Repel four direct assaults on your party in ever increasing waves of enemies. You have 1D4 rounds to erect defenses before they arrive. Make a LOCATION ROLL %LOC1% to determine the LOCATION where the COMMANDOS must defend. Reach this location and then spawn XENOS ...

EscortACivi.Label: Escort a Civi
EscortACivi.Desc: The Brass has brought in a civilian contractor, scientist, or other VIP. Escort this person to the right location and make sure nothing happens to him/her. Make a LOCATION ROLL %LOC1% to determine the LOCATION the VIP needs to reach.

SpecimenCollection.Label: Specimen Collection
SpecimenCollection.Desc: Someone in the Bio-Weapons Division wants a live specimen. Roll its LOCATION %LOC1%. Take an Electro-Net Gun and secure one of the creatures for transport. For an added ESCALATION, make the XENO unique or the first of its kind.

Demolitions.Label: Demolitions
Demolitions.Desc: It's time to blow this joint. Take a mini-nuke to a rolled LOCATION %LOC1% and set it to blow. Just be clear when the blast is set to go off -- hopefully when you are far from it.

DataRetrieval.Label: Data Retrieval
DataRetrieval.Desc: Somewhere in the facility (roll it! %LOC1%) or ship is a computer with important data. Someone has to go there, hack in manually, and save the data to portable media.

RescueOp.Label: Rescue Op
RescueOp.Desc: You just got an urgent communication from another fire team. Delta is trapped and running low on ammo at a rolled LOCATION %LOC1%. Will you make it in time to save them?

AlignTheUplinkDish.Label: Align the Uplink Dish
AlignTheUplinkDish.Desc: Before you can Evac, you're gonna have to align the satellite uplink dish and transmit your coordinates. Good luck reaching it in time.

AidASurvivor.Label: Aid a Survivor
AidASurvivor.Desc: You didn't plan on it, but darned if there wasn't a Survivor living here in the ducts. Roll LOCATION %LOC1% and get to this person, escort them to a safe location (roll it) %LOC2%, and render aid.

GetTheTech.Label: Get the Tech
GetTheTech.Desc: The Company lost a valuable piece of tech here, and they want it. Get in, find it in a rolled LOCATION %LOC1%, and bring it with you. The trouble is, it might be heavy, bulky, volatile, or dan-

WayPoints.Label: Way Points
WayPoints.Desc: Reach three LOCATIONS %LOC1% %LOC2% %LOC3% in a sequence and clear each area. The trouble is, some of the terrain might be treacherous or difficult to reach.

FindTheirOrigin.Label: Find Their Origin
FindTheirOrigin.Desc: The XENOS got in, and the Brass want answers how they ended up here. Search for 3 clues, in rolled LOCATIONS %LOC1% %LOC2% %LOC3%, piece them together, and get out with the secret.

HostileAgents.Label: Hostile Agents
HostileAgents.Desc: Rogue agents or Company Mercenaries are up to some scumbaggery. Find these opposing forces in 1D4 LOCATIONS %LOCLIST% and eliminate them. It's best not to ask too many questions.

KillMe.Label: Kill Me!
KillMe.Desc:
A member of your unit is infected, and a XENO bursts from their chest! This person makes a DEATH roll or dies instantly! Roll 1D4 on the 'Who's Infected?' table below to choose the victim. COMMANDOS that see the emerging XENO must make FEAR rolls.
1: Randomly choose a COMMANDO
2: Choose a survivor, colonist, or civilian in your group
3: The highest ranking COMMANDO
4: The lowest ranking COMMANDO

TheyCutThePower.Label: They Cut the Power!
TheyCutThePower.Desc: Everything goes dark. Add the Objective Restore Power. The Target is increased by 3 until the end of the current OBJECTIVE, and all XENOS are now in SEEK mode. Negate this effect with the Night Vision or Floodlight tag on equipment.

Blocked.Label: Blocked!
Blocked.Desc: A critical junction is blocked, either with debris, a barricade, or a locked door with a broken mechanism. The COMMANDOS work with plasma cutters to get through, but they are stopped for 1D4 ROUNDS.

FlameUnitsOnly.Label: Flame Units Only
FlameUnitsOnly.Desc: For whatever reason, the brass doesn't want anyone using projectile weapons. Complete the current OBJECTIVE using only flame units.

TheBreeder.Label: The Breeder
TheBreeder.Desc: This battle is a battle to the death and must be resolved before any further progress on the current OBJECTIVE. For this encounter only, the Target is increased by 3. If the current OBJECTIVE is Kill the Breeder, there are now two giant Breeder XENOS.

PraetorianGuards.Label: Praetorian Guards
PraetorianGuards.Desc: The XENOS in this section are much tougher than the drones and warriors you have encountered. Until the current OBJECTIVE is complete, all XENO attacks require DEATH RESISTANCES to survive.

RogueCommandos.Label: Rogue Commandos
RogueCommandos.Desc: Just when you thought things couldn't get worse, there are rogue commandos or company agents tracking you, bent on your elimination. 1D12 of them arrive via a LOCATION ROLL %LOC1%, SEEKING, and using XENO BEHAVIOR to move and attack.

UsedUp.Label: Used Up!
UsedUp.Desc: All medical equipment has been used up, the squad is in bad shape, and now COMMANDOS must improvise tourniquets and bandages. Increase the Target by 3 for all Medical rolls until the end of the current OBJECTIVE. This ESCALATION can also be nullified by getting 1 or more COMMANDOS into a medical LOCATION or a Supply Drop ESCALATION.

ManDown.Label: Man Down!
ManDown.Desc: One random COMMANDO has fallen critically ill. You don't look so good, man. This COMMANDO must be taken to a med bay within 1 TURN. Every TURN beyond that, the ill COMMANDO makes a DEATH roll or dies. If the ill COMMANDO dies CLOSE to any other COMMANDO, they become ill as well.

SomethingWicked.Label: Something Wicked
SomethingWicked.Desc: There's something moving in the darkness (roll LOCATION as normal) %LOC1%. It's terrifying and wicked fast. All of its attacks contact all NEAR COMMANDOS at once! Any COMMANDO rolls to kill the damn thing are HARD.

Fubard.Label: FUBAR'D
Fubard.Desc: Your dropship crashed on the pad. The escape pods have scrambled telemetry. Make the Align the Dish OBJECTIVE the current OBJECTIVE. Use a LOCATION ROLL %LOC1% to add the new dropship or pod to the map.

SupplyDrop.Label: Supply Drop
SupplyDrop.Desc: The COMMANDOS find a crate of weapons, ammo, and medical equipment. Decrease the Target by 3 until the end of the current OBJECTIVE for Weapon and Medical rolls.

OutOfAmmo.Label: Out of Ammo
OutOfAmmo.Desc: All COMMANDOS run out of ammunition for their main weapons and are using sidearms only. Increase the Target by 3 until the end of the current OBJECTIVE.

CombatFatigue.Label: Combat Fatigue
CombatFatigue.Desc: All COMMANDOS are exhausted and are stopped for 1D4 rounds. In addition, the Target is increased by 3 until the end of the current OBJECTIVE.

Swarm.Label: Swarm!
Swarm.Desc: The XENOS are suddenly coming from everywhere! 1D12 of them arrive immediately at the COMMANDOS' LOCATION. All COMMANDOS roll DEATH RESISTANCE or die.

Snatched.Label: Snatched!
Snatched.Desc: Randomly choose one COMMANDO. He vanishes. Victims taken in such a way are cocooned for gestation. If your squad chooses, they can add a Rescue Op OBJECTIVE.

Explosion.Label: Explosion
Explosion.Desc: Without warning, 1D4 explosions suddenly occur throughout the map. Make a LOCATION ROLL %LOCLIST% for the location of each explosion. If an explosion occurs within the COMMANDOS' Area, all COMMANDOS make a DODGE RESISTANCE roll or take 4 injuries immediately. All XENOS caught in an explosion are killed instantly.

GameOverMan.Label: Game Over, Man!
GameOverMan.Desc: The XENOS were just too deadly, the colonists are all dead, the VIP has vanished, and maybe the critical system can't be fixed. Regardless, the current OBJECTIVE is an immediate failure, and lots of good COMMANDOS died as a result. Decrease the number of COMMANDOS by half and proceed to the next OBJECTIVE.

ScentOfBlood.Label: Scent of Blood
ScentOfBlood.Desc: All XENOS at any location on the map immediately run to the COMMANDOS' area, and the Target is increased by 3 until the end of the current OBJECTIVE.

TooQuiet.Label: Too Quiet
TooQuiet.Desc: Stay frosty, watch those corners. No escalation this turn.

Chat.OffMapDesc: Not in this area. Location is {direction} from here.

SheetTheme.Name: Sheet Theme
SheetTheme.Hint: Color theme used by item sheets and chat cards.

PlayWithGM.Name: Play with a GM
PlayWithGM.Hint: Spawn rolls stay GM-only, spawned XENOS and Escalation spawns enter Hidden, and Ambush spawns enter revealed (Seek).

CombatCarousel.Name: Combat Carousel
CombatCarousel.Hint: Floating combat-order bar: MARINES act first and reorder freely, unique threats get their own card, and the Drone swarm collapses into one symbolic XENOS card.

AutoKillOnDamage.Name: Auto-Kill Xenos on Destroy Roll
AutoKillOnDamage.Hint: When a destroy die is rolled, automatically remove that many points of xeno threat from the scene, per the weapon's Kill Mode — closest to the attacker (Normal), around the target (Explosive), or along the beeline through the target (Piercing).

CarouselPosition.Name: Combat Carousel Position
CarouselPosition.Hint: Which edge of your screen the Combat Carousel is pinned to. Left/Right switch it to a vertical column. Sidebar embeds it inside the right sidebar instead of floating.

DoorIconOpacity.Name: Door Icon Opacity
DoorIconOpacity.Hint: Resting opacity of the door open/close icon on the canvas. Lower it for a more discreet icon; it still snaps to full opacity on hover.

Combat.XenosTooltip: The Xenos act — roll to spawn, resolve their attacks, then advance.
